title: Redaction map for registration/ (Manuscript A bundle)
note: Lists, for every redacted file, each JSON field (RFC 6901 JSON Pointer) whose string value was changed, the placeholder(s) inserted and the reason. No original values are recorded. Keys and the JSON structure are unchanged by the redaction (structure_sha256 is the sha256 of the sorted-as-written list of JSON paths with value types, identical for original and redacted copy). Unredacted originals are available to the editor and reviewers on request; they contain internal server addresses and are not published. Release v4: entries of v2-redacted files also give, per changed field, the server labels inserted (labels) and list renamed JSON keys (renamed_keys, pointers in the redacted copy). Entries of v2-redacted files also give, for fields where analysis-platform identifiers were replaced, the neutral tokens inserted (platform).

placeholders.<HOST>: host address (internal compute-server IP address or host label)
placeholders.<SCRATCH>: remote path (scratch directory on the compute server)
